home.thought: Love all, serve all. Help ever, hurt never.

act0.eyebrow: Sri Sathya Sai Seva Organisation · Delhi NCR
act0.title: Love all, serve all.
act0.body: Bhajans, study circles and seva (service) across Delhi NCR. Open to everyone, free always.

act1.title: Each day begins with prayer.
act1.body: Nagar Sankirtan through the lanes at dawn, and meals cooked by morning for those who need them.

act2.title: Five petals, five human values.
act2.body: Sathya, Dharma, Shanti, Prema and Ahimsa: the values behind every activity we run.

act3.title: Come as you are.
act3.body: Every activity is free and open to people of every faith.

sathya.name: Sathya
sathya.quote: Speak the truth. Speak it pleasantly.
sathya.body: Study circles meet weekly in every centre. One teaching is read, questioned and sat with until it is plain. No fee, no registration.

dharma.name: Dharma
dharma.quote: Duty is God. Work is worship.
dharma.body: Bal Vikas classes give children an hour each Sunday to learn the human values through stories, songs and silent sitting.

shanti.name: Shanti
shanti.quote: Silence is the first step to peace.
shanti.body: Bhajans (devotional singing) on Thursday and Sunday evenings, and Nagar Sankirtan through the lanes at first light. Anyone may sing.

prema.name: Prema
prema.body: Narayan Seva serves cooked meals through the year. Beside it run blood donation camps, eye camps, winter blanket rounds and hospital visits.

ahimsa.name: Ahimsa
ahimsa.body: Sapling drives through the monsoon, park and lake clean-ups, and water-saving work in schools.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.lead: We collect as little as we can, keep it only as long as we need it, and never sell it or share it for anyone's marketing.

short.s1: We mostly store counts: how many people came, never who.
short.s2: We store a few personal details only for follow-up care, such as a cataract operation, and only with your consent.
short.s3: We never ask for Aadhaar or any other ID number.
short.s4: You can ask us to see, correct or delete your details at any time.
short.s5: To contact us, use the request form on this page. We reply within 30 days.

sathya.introTitle: One person, all the way through
sathya.lead: Sathya (truth) is the first of the five human values. It is not only saying what is so. It is when what we think, what we say and what we do are the same thing.
sathya.practiceBody: A study circle is a small group that reads one teaching aloud, asks what it means for this week, and sits with it until it is plain. Nobody lectures. Anyone may speak, and anyone may simply listen.
sathya.ctaTitle: Sit in on a study circle
sathya.ctaBody: Come once and listen. No registration, no reading in advance, no fee. Find the nearest centre and walk in.
sathya.livedBody: Truth runs through study circles, seva and Bal Vikas alike. See them all in one place.
sathya.s1d: Seeing a situation as it is, before deciding how we would like it to be.
sathya.s2d: Saying what is true, gently, and keeping the promises we make, small ones first.
sathya.s3d: Doing what we said we would do, the same way whether or not anyone is watching.
sathya.t1q: Truth is God. Live in truth.
sathya.t2q: Let your thoughts, words and deeds be in harmony.
sathya.t3q: Sathyam vada, dharmam chara: speak the truth, walk in right conduct.

dharma.introTitle: The duty in front of us
dharma.lead: Dharma (right conduct) is truth put into practice. It is doing the duty in front of us, at home, at work, in the street, well and without waiting to be asked.
dharma.practiceBody: Bal Vikas (blossoming of the child) gives children an hour a week with the values their parents live by, through stories, songs, silent sitting and small group work. Classes are taught by trained gurus (teachers) and are free for every child, of every faith.
dharma.ctaTitle: Enrol a child in Bal Vikas
dharma.ctaBody: Classes run on Sunday mornings at every centre. Bring your child once to see. There is no fee, no uniform and no test.
dharma.livedBody: Sunday values classes for children aged 5 to 15, free for every child.
dharma.s1d: Care for parents and children, shared work in the kitchen, and patience at the end of a long day.
dharma.s2d: Honest effort and fair dealing, whether the job is large or small, seen or unseen.
dharma.s3d: Giving a little time each week to people we will never be thanked by.
dharma.t1q: Duty without love is deplorable. Duty with love is desirable. Love without duty is divine.
dharma.t2q: Where there is righteousness in the heart, there is beauty in the character.
dharma.t3q: Dharmo rakshati rakshitah: dharma protects those who protect it.

shanti.introTitle: A calm we carry with us
shanti.lead: Shanti (peace) is what remains when truth and right conduct are steady. It is not the absence of noise around us, but a stillness we can carry into a crowded bus, a hard meeting or a sleepless night.
shanti.practiceBody: Bhajans (devotional singing) are held on Thursday and Sunday evenings in every centre, with songs from many faiths and languages. One voice leads, everyone answers. Nagar Sankirtan (singing through the lanes at first light) runs on festival mornings. Anyone may sing, and anyone may simply listen.
shanti.ctaTitle: Come to an evening of bhajans
shanti.ctaBody: Sit at the back if you like. Songbooks are on every mat, and nobody minds if you only listen. Thursdays and Sundays, in the evening.
shanti.livedBody: Devotional singing on Thursday and Sunday evenings in every centre.
shanti.s1d: A few minutes each morning without a screen, simply sitting and letting the mind settle.
shanti.s2d: Singing the divine name together, so that many voices become one breath.
shanti.s3d: Pausing before replying, and letting small irritations pass without passing them on.
shanti.t1q: Peace is the inner silence of the mind.
shanti.t2q: Bhajan is the best way to purify the mind.
shanti.t3q: Om shanti, shanti, shantih: peace within, peace around, peace everywhere.

prema.lead: Prema (love) is the thread that runs through the other four values. It is not a feeling kept to ourselves. It shows up as a meal served warm, a hand held in a hospital ward, a stranger treated as family.
prema.practiceBody: Narayan Seva (serving the divine in every person) means cooked meals prepared at the centre and served by hand, every week of the year. Beside it run blood donation camps, winter blanket rounds and hospital visits. Nothing is ever collected from the people we serve.
prema.ctaBody: Pick a seva that needs Sevadal and tell us you are coming. Nothing is ever collected from the public.
prema.livedBody: Cooked meals served by hand, blood donation and hospital visits, every week of the year.
prema.s1d: Noticing who has gone without, before they have to ask.
prema.s2d: Turning up with hands, week after week, expecting nothing back.
prema.s3d: Serving every person the same way, whatever their faith, caste or circumstance.
prema.t1q: Start the day with love. Fill the day with love. End the day with love.
prema.t2q: Hands that help are holier than lips that pray.
prema.t3q: There is only one religion, the religion of love.

ahimsa.lead: Ahimsa (non-violence) grows naturally from the other four values. It asks us to cause no harm, not only to people, but to animals, to rivers, to the air and the soil we share.
ahimsa.practiceBody: Environmental seva (service to the earth) gathers Sevadal members on weekend mornings to plant saplings, clean ghats and parks, and run water-saving drives in schools. Every drive is coordinated with the local resident welfare association.
ahimsa.ctaBody: Bring water and a cap. Tools and saplings are provided, and children are welcome with a parent.
ahimsa.livedBody: Environmental seva sits within the Service Wing, beside every other programme.
ahimsa.s1d: Choosing words that do not wound, even when we disagree.
ahimsa.s2d: Taking only what we need, and wasting less water, food and power.
ahimsa.s3d: Planting, cleaning and restoring the places we live in.
ahimsa.t1q: Do not hurt anyone by word or deed.
ahimsa.t2q: See God in every living being.
ahimsa.t3q: Ahimsa paramo dharmah: non-violence is the highest duty.

about.metaDescription: The Sri Sathya Sai Seva Organisation in Delhi NCR: Sevadal members who meet to sing, study and serve. Free and open to people of every faith.
about.title: Neighbours who serve
about.lead: The Sri Sathya Sai Seva Organisation in Delhi NCR is a group of Sevadal members who meet to sing, study and serve. Everything we do is free and open to people of every faith.
about.founderP1: Bhagawan taught that service to people is service to God, and that all faiths lead to the same truth. He asked that nothing be collected from those we serve.
about.founderP2: The organisation he founded now works in more than 100 countries. In Delhi NCR, it began with a handful of bhajan groups in the 1960s.
about.founderQuote: Love all, serve all. Help ever, hurt never.
about.wingsSub: Every activity sits in one wing. Open one to see its programmes.
about.wingDesc_service: Medical camps, Narayan Seva, blood donation and village seva.
about.wingDesc_educational: Bal Vikas classes for children and values education in schools.
about.wingDesc_spiritual: Bhajans (devotional singing), study circles and Nagar Sankirtan.
about.wingDesc_mahila: Seva and study led by the women of each centre.
about.wingDesc_youth: Seva, study and leadership for 18 to 40 year olds.
about.orgSub: A samithi is a local centre. Each one belongs to a district.
about.orgFoot: {count, plural, one {# samithi, with its own centre page} other {# samithis, each with its own centre page}}
about.orgEmpty: District pages will appear here soon.
about.p1d: No fees for any class, camp or bhajan. Ever.
about.p2d: Songs and readings come from many traditions. No one is asked to convert.
about.p3d: We never ask the public for money. Donations go only through the official page.
about.findBody: Every samithi (local centre) meets weekly. Walk in; no one will ask why you came.
about.contactBody: For questions about seva or classes, call or message the centre nearest to you. Each centre page lists its number.
